notebook_justification: The observer was blinded for object recognition but blinding for other tests is not specified.
notebook_verbatim: [p.406, Object recognition test] "recorded by an observer who was blind to treatment"
gold_justification: For the anxiety outcomes the observer was present ~1 m away and unblinded.

notebook_justification: The study was conducted by academic institutions with no evidence of commercial influence.
notebook_verbatim: [p.403, Header] "Universidade Regional de Blumenau, Blumenau, SC, Brazil"
gold_justification: No funding statement; funder role cannot be assessed.

notebook_justification: Authors identify the need for investigation into the effects of background noise masking.
notebook_verbatim: [p.81, Discussion] "However, the effect of background noise... in masking the effects of ultrasound and loud noises needs further investigation."
gold_justification: Discussion offers mechanism and future directions but no specific limitation of this study.

notebook_verbatim: [p.2, Experimental Design] "NH+PAS plus an additional PAS exposure during FST (NH+PAS/FST+PAS; n = 7-8)"
gold_justification: Outcomes align with methods, but subject age is internally contradictory (8-10 months in Methods vs 8-10 weeks in figures).

notebook_justification: Allocation and analysis denominators generally match, but some results show n=5 while others show n=7-8 without explicit exclusion reasons.
notebook_verbatim: [p.6, Fig 3] "n = 7–8 per group."
gold_justification: 73 allocated; experiment groups sum to 73 with per-group n reported; histology subsample (n=5) stated.

notebook_justification: Methods for behavioral tests and results for distance, immobility, and latency are coherent.
notebook_verbatim: [p.14-17, Results] "Significant influence of the environment was found in travelled distance"
gold_justification: Outcomes reported, but ANOVA error df (~59) is inconsistent with the stated n=32 animals.

notebook_justification: States that videos recorded during behavioral experiments were coded to avoid bias.
notebook_verbatim: [p.333, Statistical analysis] "The videos recorded during the behavioural experiments were coded to avoid bias."
gold_justification: Blinding via coded videos mentioned but with limited detail.

notebook_justification: Supported by academic and government innovation funds.
notebook_verbatim: [p.77, Acknowledgments] "supported by Natural Science Foundation of China (no. 30725020, 30700258)..."
gold_justification: No funding statement located; funder role cannot be assessed.

notebook_justification: Observer mentioned but blinding status not reported.
notebook_verbatim: [p.108, Methods] "The observer stayed in the same room approximately one meter away from each apparatus"
gold_justification: Observer present ~1 m away during tests; judgment-sensitive outcome unblinded.
Some methodological reflection (absence of a stressor) and recommendations, but no dedicated limitations.

notebook_justification: Treatment is confounded with separate rooms with no reported matching or room swap.
notebook_verbatim: [p.6, Methods] "The silence room was exactly the same as the room in which music were played but here there was no sounds"
gold_justification: Silence and music rooms described as identical except sound – matched but still a residual room confound.

notebook_justification: Observer mentioned but blinding status not reported.
notebook_verbatim: [p.6, Methods] "The observer stayed in the same room, 1 m or so away from the elevated plus-maze and open-field"
gold_justification: Observer scored behaviour live in the same room with music playing; judgment-sensitive outcome unblinded.

notebook_justification: Likely comparable homogeneous animals used but no arm-specific baseline balance data reported.
notebook_verbatim: [p.349, Methods] "Male Wistar rats... age of fourteen weeks, demonstrating depressive-like behavior in the treatment group as determined by the Sucrose Preference Test (SPT)."
gold_justification: Pre-CUMS baseline body weights reported per group and not significantly different.

notebook_justification: Reports music stimulus, delivery method, duration, frequency, intensity, and control condition.
notebook_verbatim: [p.349, Methods] "Mozart music (K448) was delivered at a volume of 60-80 dB... from 6:00 pm to 6:00 am... duration extended for 21 days... separate room was designated for groups without music exposure"
gold_justification: Genre/piece, volume, schedule, duration and control given, but speaker/delivery hardware not described.

notebook_justification: Treatment is confounded with separate room with no reported room swap or environmental matching.
notebook_verbatim: [p.349, Methods] "A separate room was designated for groups without music exposure, and the entire treatment duration extended for 21 days."
gold_justification: Music vs no-music in separate rooms; collective housing 2/cage with pups/animals not independent.

notebook_justification: SPT and assays were assessed at fixed post-treatment timepoints for all animals.
notebook_verbatim: [p.349, Methods] "Sucrose preference tests were carried out... 21 days post-treatment started... All rats underwent euthanasia 24 hours after the last treatment"
gold_justification: Animals were included into the treatment group based on showing the target phenotype (low SPT).

notebook_justification: Starting group sizes match analysis denominators reconciled in Figure 1 and Table 1.
notebook_verbatim: [p.350, Table 1] "CUMS (n=8) CUMS+F (n=7) CUMS+F+M (n=7) CUMS+M (n=8) Control (n=9)"
gold_justification: 42 allocated but only 39 analysed; the 3 lost are unexplained.

notebook_justification: Reports species, strain, sex, age, and identifiable group sizes.
notebook_verbatim: [p.3, Methods] "Wild-type C57BL/6 male mice (8 weeks old) were used. Experimental groups were divided into groups of WT mice without any intentional acoustic stimuli (WT, n=10)..."
gold_justification: Strain, sex and age reported, but body weight and animal supplier not given.

notebook_justification: Reports approval by the university's institutional ethical committee.
notebook_verbatim: [p.3, Methods] "All animal studies were carried out in strict conformity with the Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine’s institutional ethical standards on animal care."
gold_justification: States adherence to laboratory animal care but no ethics-committee approval reported.

notebook_justification: Technically sound design with acoustic baffle and white noise control.
notebook_verbatim: [p.3, Methods] "Whatever experimental conditions or groups considered (WN and M), an acoustic baffle adjusted to 70 dB was placed 1 m from the cages, which ensures a correct auditory perception"
gold_justification: Careful matched-dB delivery with an acoustic baffle, but paired housing introduces mild pseudoreplication.

notebook_justification: Reports compliance with European Communities Council Directive protocol.
notebook_verbatim: [p.2, Methods] "Experiments were carried out in accordance with the European Communities Council Directive (2010/63/UE)..."
gold_justification: Names EU directive compliance but no ethics-committee approval reported.

notebook_justification: Silent on whether handlers delivering the intervention were blinded.
notebook_verbatim: [p.3, Methods] NOT REPORTED IN PAPER
gold_justification: Experimenter blinded to the music/white-noise condition.

notebook_justification: Reports species, strain, sex, weight, and identifiable group sizes.
notebook_verbatim: [p.2, Methods] "Fifty-six adult male Wistar rats (200–250 gr) divided into four main groups (14 rats for each group)... were used."
gold_justification: Strain, sex, weight and n given, but animal age not reported.

notebook_justification: Authors identify one caveat regarding duration of music exposure.
notebook_verbatim: [p.7, Conclusions] "This discrepancy may have arisen from the difference in duration of music exposure."
gold_justification: No study-specific limitations discussed.

notebook_justification: Reports species, strain, sex, age, and identifiable group sizes.
notebook_verbatim: [p.2, Methods] "Male (n = 10) and female (n = 10) Wistar rats were used... performed when the animals were approximately 1 month old..."
gold_justification: Strain, sex and n given, but body weight, supplier and housing details not reported.

notebook_justification: Reports stimulus piece, intensity level in dB, and exposure duration.
notebook_verbatim: [p.2, Methods] "Mozart’s Sonata for Two Pianos was played at a sound intensity of 65 dB for 4 hours per day... for 4 days"
gold_justification: Genre/piece, volume, duration and schedule given, but the control condition and delivery hardware are not clearly described.

notebook_justification: Authors identify concrete caveats regarding adaptive memory and missing hormone data.
notebook_verbatim: [p.10, Discussion] "cognitive responses... were not affected, which was likely due to the learning that occurred via test repetition... levels of hormones... were not measured in our study"
gold_justification: No study-specific limitations discussed.

notebook_justification: Reports species, strain, sex, gestational age, and group sizes.
notebook_verbatim: [p.2, Methods] "Adult female and male Wistar albino rats were housed... Dams (n=12) and pups (n=34) in each music groups..."
gold_justification: Strain and sex given and exposure window defined, but pup sex/weight and animal supplier not reported.

notebook_justification: Reports stimulus pieces, intensity levels in dB, duration, and schedule.
notebook_verbatim: [p.2, Methods] "classical music group (Canon in D Major/ Johann Pachelbel, 60 dB)... Sufi music group (Whirling Derwish/ Omar Faruk Tekbilek, 30 dB)... rock music group (In Your Face/ Children of Bodom, 120 dB)... listened to their own music 1 hour/day"
gold_justification: Genre/piece/artist, volume, duration and schedule given, but delivery hardware/placement not described.

notebook_justification: Cage position randomization or control is not reported.
notebook_verbatim: [p.2, Methods] NOT REPORTED IN PAPER
gold_justification: One cage per group requiring acoustic isolation; no counterbalancing possible.

notebook_justification: Methods and Results align for behavioral, hormonal, and oxidative stress outcomes.
notebook_verbatim: [p.3, Results] "depression-like behavior was evaluated by TST (Figure 1)... ACTH, CORT, and iPTH were measured by ELISA method"
gold_justification: Outcomes reported but per-measure denominators vary across analyses without explanation.

notebook_justification: Denominators match allocation for both dams and pups in figures.
notebook_verbatim: [p.3, Results] "One-way ANOVA revealed that there was a significant treatment effect among groups (F(3:45)=5.855, p=0.002)."
gold_justification: Variable n across assays not reconciled to allocation; no clear flow.

notebook_justification: Authors identify hearing frequency perception and perinatal complexity as limitations.
notebook_verbatim: [p.5, Discussion] "the fact that different hearing frequency of rat results a different perception of music type than human may be an important limitation"
gold_justification: One substantive but brief limitation (rat hearing/perception) stated.
